system.description:
AUDITORY CLERIC SOUL UTILITY
Cleric Specialist Spell
Cast 2 AP (verbal)
Area 30-foot emanation
Duration 1 minute

You begin a sustained litany of reassurance, doctrine and shared conviction. Those who hear you draw strength from the certainty of those standing beside them.
You and willing allies within the emanation gain the following benefit.
Once during the spell's duration, when an affected creature attempts a saving throw against an effect possessing the Curse, Fear, Mental or Soul trait, it may improve the final result of that saving throw by one degree.
Failure becomes Partial.
Partial becomes Success.
Fumble becomes Failure.
Blunder becomes Fumble.
A creature must decide to use this benefit after the saving throw is rolled but before its effects are resolved.
Once a creature has improved a saving throw using Communal Litany, it cannot benefit from the spell again during that casting.
The benefit is lost while outside the emanation but returns if the creature re-enters before the spell ends, provided it has not already used its benefit.

Warping Options:
+2 PP: Increase the emanation by 10 feet.
+2 PP: A creature may use the benefit twice during the duration, but never more than once against the same effect.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10. Each ally in the emanation may improve one saving throw against a Curse, Fear, Mental or Soul effect by one degree — offered after the roll.
